exercises.name: Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back, below the neck, and brace your torso.
Sit down and slightly back, knees tracking over your toes, until your hips reach at least knee height.
Drive through the whole foot to stand up, keeping your chest and hips rising together.

exercises.name: Front Squat
instructions: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with elbows high.
Squat straight down, keeping your torso upright.
Stand by pushing the floor away while keeping the elbows up.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest.
Squat between your knees, keeping the chest tall.
Stand up by driving through your mid-foot.

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Place feet shoulder-width on the platform and release the safeties.
Lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees without your lower back lifting off the pad.
Press back up without locking the knees hard.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
instructions: Stand with your back against the pad and shoulders under the yokes.
Lower under control until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Drive back up through the whole foot.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and step your feet slightly forward.
Squat down under control.
Stand up while keeping tension through the legs.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms forward for balance.
Sit down until your hips reach knee height or lower.
Stand back up with control.

exercises.name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace, pull the slack out of the bar and push the floor away, keeping the bar close.
Lock out by squeezing the glutes; lower by pushing the hips back.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the bar at hip height with soft knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive the hips forward to return to standing, keeping your back neutral.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips, keeping the weights close to your legs, until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Return to standing by driving the hips forward.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside the bar and grip the handles.
Brace and push the floor away until you are standing tall.
Lower by sitting the hips back and down.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the bar over your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Pause and squeeze, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hike the bell back between your legs with a flat back.
Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge to absorb it.

exercises.name: Back Extension
instructions: Set the pad just below your hips.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips.
Raise until your body forms a straight line; avoid over-arching.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front foot and step into the next rep. Count reps per leg.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rest your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up through the front foot. Count reps per leg.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Step one foot back and lower the back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso tall and front knee over the foot.
Push through the front heel to return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Place one foot fully on a box or bench.
Drive through that foot to stand on top without pushing off the back leg.
Step down under control.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Align your knees with the machine pivot.
Extend the legs fully and pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels.
Curl the pad toward your glutes while keeping hips down.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit with the pad above your heels and the thigh pad secured.
Curl down as far as possible.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored.
Lower your body forward as slowly as you can, keeping hips extended.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise as high as possible and pause.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs.
Lower the heels fully.
Press up as high as possible.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Sit with pads on the inside of your knees.
Squeeze your legs together.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Sit with pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your knees apart.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pulled back and down.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest with forearms vertical.
Press up and slightly back to lockout. Use a spotter or safeties for heavy sets.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to 30–45 degrees.
Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press back to lockout over your shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back with dumbbells over your chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest with elbows about 45 degrees from your torso.
Press back up. Log the weight of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to 30–45 degrees.
Lower the dumbbells to your upper chest.
Press up until arms are straight. Log the weight of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles are at mid-chest.
Press forward until arms are extended.
Return slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Position the bench so the bar lowers to mid-chest.
Unrack and lower under control.
Press to lockout and re-rack with the hooks.

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, body in a straight line.
Push back up. Elevate your hands to make it easier.

exercises.name: Dip
instructions: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, leaning slightly forward.
Press back up. Skip if it irritates your shoulders.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set the pulleys at chest height and step forward.
With a slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in an arc.
Return slowly to a stretch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie back with dumbbells over your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Bring the weights back together in an arc.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles are at chest height.
Bring the handles together in front of you.
Return under control.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
instructions: Hold the bar on your front shoulders, grip just outside shoulder width.
Brace your glutes and abs, then press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly.
Lock out with the bar over your mid-foot, then lower to the shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit upright with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead until arms are straight.
Lower to shoulder height. Log the weight of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles start at shoulder height.
Press up to full extension.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at shoulder height.
Press up and forward until your arm is extended.
Lower with control. A shoulder-friendly alternative to overhead pressing.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly. Log the weight of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley holding the handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides, leading with the elbows.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope at upper-chest height.
Pull toward your face, separating the hands and rotating the arms outward.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving the elbows down.
Lower to a full hang. Log added weight if you use a belt.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower to a full hang.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Kneel on the pad; the logged weight is the assistance.
Pull your chest up toward the handles.
Lower to full extension. Progress by reducing assistance.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and secure your thighs.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving the elbows down.
Let it rise until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower under control without letting your torso rise.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Lower to a full stretch. Count reps per arm.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with a slight bend in the knees.
Row the handle to your stomach, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Reach forward under control.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench.
Row the dumbbells up, driving elbows back.
Lower to a full stretch. Easy on the lower back.

exercises.name: Machine Row
instructions: Set the chest pad so you can reach the handles with straight arms.
Pull the handles back, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hang under a bar set at hip height, body straight.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control. Walk your feet back to make it easier.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold the bar at arm's length.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause, then lower.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Hold the bar with an underhand grip at shoulder width.
Curl it up without swinging your torso.
Lower fully under control.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Grip the angled sections of the bar.
Curl up, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl up without moving your elbows forward.
Lower slowly. Log the weight of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up keeping the neutral grip.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
instructions: Attach a bar to a low pulley.
Curl up keeping your elbows fixed.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit back on a bench set to about 60 degrees, arms hanging.
Curl without bringing the elbows forward.
Lower to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Hold a bar or rope at a high pulley, elbows at your sides.
Push down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise until your forearms are just above parallel.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Face away from a pulley with the rope behind your head.
Extend your arms overhead.
Lower behind your head to a deep stretch.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding the bar over your forehead.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Extend back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows.
Extend back up.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Grip the bar about shoulder width.
Lower to your lower chest with elbows tucked.
Press to lockout.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Curl the weights up with your wrists.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Support yourself on forearms and toes.
Keep a straight line from head to heels, squeezing glutes and abs.
Hold for time; stop when your hips sag.

exercises.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and support yourself on one forearm.
Lift your hips so your body is straight.
Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar.
Raise your legs by curling your pelvis up, not just lifting the legs.
Lower without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley holding the rope by your head.
Crunch down by flexing your spine.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel holding the wheel under your shoulders.
Roll forward as far as you can without your lower back arching.
Pull back using your abs.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms up and knees over hips.
Extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping your lower back on the floor.
Return and alternate.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand side-on to a pulley at chest height.
Press the handle straight out and resist rotation.
Bring it back to your chest.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Pick up heavy dumbbells or kettlebells.
Walk tall with short, quick steps.
Log the weight of one implement and the distance walked.

exercises.name: Running
instructions: Warm up with a few minutes of easy jogging.
Run at the planned intensity.
Log distance and time.

exercises.name: Incline Walk
instructions: Set an incline you can sustain while walking without holding the rails.
Walk at a steady pace.
Log distance and time.

exercises.name: Cycling
instructions: Set the saddle so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Ride at the planned intensity.
Log distance and time.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive with the legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your ribs.
Return in reverse order: arms, body, legs.
Log distance and time.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the handles at hip height.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Log the time.
